uid_policy: UID 1000 reserved for mobile; future composer must refuse any existing conflicting UID/name/home ownership before installing
device_access: logind active-seat mediation; no raw block, kmem, module loading or permanent input group
privilege_requests: narrow authenticated polkit operations; review each rule before composition
secrets: root-owned 0600 Wi-Fi/Tailscale files outside Git; no session-environment export or log capture
lock_screen: BLOCKED until Denial lock authentication and input isolation are physically qualified
data_at_rest: BLOCKED: no qualified encrypted mobile userdata composition
unlocked_bootloader: Physical possession permits replacement boot code; encryption alone does not establish verified boot or prevent credential capture
updates: Signed exact-artifact verification, rollback protection and signed rescue preserved; no mutable package upgrade promoted to accepted image
lost_device: Revoke Tailscale node and SSH credentials from another trusted host; remote wipe is not promised; offline exposure follows encryption and boot threat model
session_entry: packaging/arch/mobile/denial-mobile-session; prepared, not installed; requires process-owned active local logind session and explicit machine-configured devices/output
pam_prerequisites: Preserve authenticated PAM package helper permissions. Qualified PAM1.7.2-2 unix_chkpwd is root:root06755; NoNewPrivs=1 prevents its password check. Entry refuses known incompatible state, never changes privileges. Synthetic ARM64 backend tests do not qualify real login or lock-screen isolation.
